# Acme Robotics

## Summary

Acme Robotics sells warehouse automation hardware. We think the time-to-value
story is real and the Series A pricing is defensible.

## Team

- Ada Okonkwo, CEO — previously led controls engineering.
- Grace Lin, CTO — previously led perception.

## Funding

The Series A was **$12M**, led by Initech Ventures.

## Risks

Hardware margins are thin, and the incumbents have distribution.
